findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if a key is compromised and violates CIS AWS Foundations benchmark control for KMS key rotation.

No key policy is defined for this customer-managed key, so it falls back to the default policy granting the entire account root (and thus any IAM principal with KMS permissions) full control over the key used to encrypt the logs bucket. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict encrypt/decrypt and administrative actions to specific principals.
